card.name: Second part of out- verbs
card.fires_on: The piece right after the prefix "out" in verbs meaning to exceed or surpass, such as outsold, outnumbered, outrun, outlive, outlast, outpace, outgrow, outstrip, outweigh.

modes.label: Out- plus verb stem
modes.description: The verb stem or ending right after "out" in a comparative "surpass" verb.

modes.label: Outlast and outlive
modes.description: The stem after "out" in verbs about surviving or enduring longer than something.

modes.label: Outweigh ending
modes.description: The ending after "outweigh", as in benefits outweighing risks.

card.writes: It adds little clear output beyond a loose sense of beating or surpassing something.
card.plain: It fires inside words like outlast, outlive and outpace, right after the "out" part.
